units.source_text: 发长彦抱着两只狗，带着两位公主，一起骑坐在黑狗背上，从笠置山飞往京城飞鸟国大臣的府邸。

en.t: Hatsunagahiko held the two dogs, brought the two princesses with him, and together they rode on the black dog's back, flying from Mount Kasagi to the mansion of the Asuka minister in the capital.

units.source_text: 中途，两位公主不知道为什么，将自己头上的金簪、银簪偷偷插在发长彦的长发之上。

en.t: Along the way, for some unknown reason, the two princesses secretly tucked their gold and silver hairpins into Hatsunagahiko's long hair.

units.source_text: 当然，发长彦对此毫无察觉，只是在空中俯瞰大和国美丽的山河，催促黑狗飞的更快些。

en.t: Of course, Hatsunagahiko noticed none of this; he simply looked down from the sky at the beautiful mountains and rivers of Yamato and urged the black dog to fly faster.
